why: Per-item states for the entries the record view adds beyond the display names (De-Dupe UI, 2026-11-25). The view lists a credit's sort name and an organization's alternate names as their own entries, sorted with the rest, so the states array must carry one state for each in the same place. Directors: Ann Lee (sort name 'Lee, Ann') matches, so both entries are identical; Bo Diddley (sort name 'Diddley, Bo') has no counterpart, so both are neutral; the view interleaves them by sort order. Organizations: Northwind Media Group (alternate name NW Media) has the submission's party id under a different name, so both of its entries are identical by the equal-party-id rule, not by name similarity; Zenith Studio has no counterpart (neutral). Fails if a loader drops sort_name or alt_names (the arrays shift), if a sort name or alternate name does not carry its person's or organization's state, or if organizations are matched by name alone. SCOPE: the sort-name and alternate-name entries and the party-id rule; nothing about scores.
